# Efe Varol Bedelcigil

> Electrical & Electronics Engineering student at Ege University, focused on control systems and robotics, with interests in embedded systems, power electronics, mechatronics and IoT.

This repository contains the source and generated artwork for my GitHub profile. The portfolio is the main destination for projects, publications and contact information. Activity graphics represent public GitHub activity; learning and exploration sections describe different stages of familiarity, not equivalent expertise.

## Profile and portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://efebedelcigil.github.io/en/): All projects, publications, contact information and more.
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/efebedelcigil): Public repositories and current profile.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/efevarolbedelcigil/): Professional profile.
- [Profile README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/efebedelcigil/efebedelcigil/main/README.md): Current generated landing page.
- [Profile content](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/efebedelcigil/efebedelcigil/main/assets/profile.json): Institution, discipline, working areas and learning/exploration areas.

- [Editing guide](https://github.com/efebedelcigil/efebedelcigil/blob/main/docs/PROFILE-EDITING.md): Source files, every card and the rebuild process.
